_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Senegal covering Senegambian stone circles, Wolof/Jolof confederation, Gorée Island slave trade, French Four Communes, Léopold Sédar Senghor and négritude, stable democracy, and Casamance conflict.

910.name: Prehistoric Senegal and Senegambian Stone Circles
910.description: Megaliths of the Senegambia; shell middens; early agricultural and fishing communities along the Senegal and Gambia rivers.

sub_clusters.name: Senegambian Stone Circles (UNESCO)
sub_clusters.description: Over 1,000 megalithic laterite stone circles at Sine Ngayène and Wanar; funerary monuments spanning nearly two millennia.

sub_clusters.name: Early Settlement and Iron Age Communities
sub_clusters.description: Shell middens on the coast; iron smelting; fishing and agriculture along Senegal River; foundation for later states.

920.name: Jolof Confederation and Wolof States
920.description: Ndiadiane Ndiaye founds the Jolof Empire; confederation of Wolof, Serer, and other states; trans-Saharan connections.

sub_clusters.name: Jolof Empire and Confederation
sub_clusters.description: Jolof unites Cayor, Baol, Waalo, Sine, Saloum under Bourba Jolof; caste system; Wolof political culture.

sub_clusters.name: Battle of Danki and Breakup of Jolof
sub_clusters.description: Cayor defeats Jolof at Battle of Danki 1549; Wolof states become independent; Atlantic trade reorients power to coast.

930.name: Atlantic Trade and Gorée Island
930.description: Portuguese, Dutch, French, and British compete for Senegambian trade; Gorée as slave trade hub; gum arabic trade on the Senegal River.

sub_clusters.name: Gorée Island and the Slave Trade
sub_clusters.description: Gorée Island as European slave trading depot; Maison des Esclaves; symbol of the Atlantic slave trade (UNESCO).

sub_clusters.name: Signares and Métis Society
sub_clusters.description: Powerful Afro-European women (signares) dominate Saint-Louis and Gorée commerce; hybrid Franco-African culture.

sub_clusters.name: Cayor Kingdom and Damel Wars
sub_clusters.description: Cayor as dominant Wolof state; Lat Dior Diop resists French and railroad; ceddo warrior culture.

940.name: French Colonisation of Senegal
940.description: Faidherbe's expansion; Four Communes citizenship; AOF capital Dakar; groundnut economy; Islamic brotherhoods.

sub_clusters.name: Faidherbe's Expansion and Conquest
sub_clusters.description: Governor Faidherbe expands from Saint-Louis; subjugates Toucouleur and Wolof states; railway built.

sub_clusters.name: Four Communes and African Citizenship
sub_clusters.description: Saint-Louis, Gorée, Rufisque, Dakar grant French citizenship to African originaires; Blaise Diagne elected 1914.

sub_clusters.name: Mouride Brotherhood and Amadou Bamba
sub_clusters.description: Amadou Bamba founds Mouride Sufi order; colonial exile and resistance; Touba as holy city; groundnut farming.

sub_clusters.name: Dakar as AOF Capital
sub_clusters.description: Dakar becomes capital of French West Africa; port, railway hub, military base; Thiaroye massacre 1944.

950.name: Independence and Léopold Sédar Senghor Era
950.description: Senghor's négritude philosophy; Mali Federation; independence 1960; single-party to multiparty transition.

sub_clusters.name: Négritude and Senghor's Intellectual Legacy
sub_clusters.description: Senghor co-founds négritude with Aimé Césaire; celebrates Black identity; poet-president model.

sub_clusters.name: Independence of Senegal
sub_clusters.description: Senegal independent 4 April 1960 after Mali Federation collapse; Senghor first president.

sub_clusters.name: Senghor's Presidency and Controlled Democracy
sub_clusters.description: Socialist party dominance; limited multiparty system from 1974; voluntary retirement 1980—rare in Africa.

950.name: Abdou Diouf Era
950.description: Diouf succeeds Senghor; full multiparty democracy; Casamance conflict; economic liberalisation; Sopi movement.

sub_clusters.name: Casamance Separatist Conflict
sub_clusters.description: MFDC rebellion in Casamance; ethnic Diola grievances; low-intensity conflict; intermittent peace talks.

sub_clusters.name: Diouf's Democratic Opening
sub_clusters.description: Full multiparty politics; structural adjustment; 1988 election crisis; gradual liberalisation; defeated 2000.

960.name: Contemporary Senegal
960.description: Alternance démocratique; Wade and Sall presidencies; democratic consolidation; economic ambitions; 2024 political crisis.

sub_clusters.name: Abdoulaye Wade Presidency
sub_clusters.description: Wade wins historic 2000 alternance; African Renaissance Monument; third-term controversy; defeated 2012.

sub_clusters.name: Macky Sall Presidency
sub_clusters.description: Sall wins 2012; infrastructure development; oil and gas discoveries; 2024 political crisis over Sonko's candidacy.

sub_clusters.name: 2024 Political Transition and Diomaye Faye
sub_clusters.description: Bassirou Diomaye Faye and Ousmane Sonko win 2024 election; youngest African president; sovereignty and reform agenda.

sub_clusters.name: Oil and Gas Economy
sub_clusters.description: Sangomar oil and GTA gas fields; partnership with Mauritania; potential economic transformation.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
